instruction: Configure VLC so that opening video files from the file manager does not start multiple VLC windows.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling one instance mode in VLC. The evaluator uses existing check_one_instance_when_started_from_file metric to verify the vlcrc config file has one-instance-when-started-from-file=0 (enabled). Default value is 1 (disabled/multiple instances allowed), so user must navigate to VLC preferences and enable the one instance mode setting.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (get_vlc_config) correctly retrieves the VLC configuration file from OS-specific location
Metric (check_one_instance_when_started_from_file) correctly checks the one-instance-when-started-from-file setting in the config file
Expected value is semantically correct: 0 means one instance mode enabled, which matches the instruction requirement
Complete coverage: instruction requires enabling one instance mode, evaluator verifies exactly this setting
Proper parameter handling: metric correctly accesses rule parameter directly without incorrect .get('rules') pattern
Appropriate postconfig: kills and relaunches VLC to ensure clean state before verification
